P.name: Vow of the First Lands
P.title: Template:Data Yunara/Vow of the First Lands
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Vow of the First Lands|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Yunara
|skill        = I
|icon         = Yunara Vow of the First Lands.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} deal {{tip|critical strike|{{as|10%|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = magic 
|spelleffects = proc
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* The '''bonus''' damage is calculated based on the total damage of the critical strike {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}}.
* The '''bonus''' damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{sti|{{as|life steal}}}}.
* If the ''critical strike'' is {{as|magic damage}} then ''Vow of the First Lands'' amps it directly. Otherwise, it deals it as a new instance of {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} tagged as having ''critically struck''.
** When dealt as a new instance, it can ''critically strike'' again (e.g {{ii|Shadowflame}}), successivelly causing ''Vow of the First Lands'' to apply again on itself as an amp. {{bug|2}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Yunara Vow of the First Lands.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Yunara}} {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
}}

Q.name: Cultivation of Spirit

Q.wikitext:
{{#vardefine:pb1|5}}{{#vardefine:pb5|25}}{{#vardefine:pap|20}}{{#vardefine:ab1|5}}{{#vardefine:ab5|25}}{{#vardefine:aap|20}}{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Cultivation of Spirit|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Yunara |skill = Q |icon = Yunara Cultivation of Spirit 2.png |icon2 = Yunara Cultivation of Spirit.png |description = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. While this ability is inactive, her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Unleash'' for 6 seconds, increased to 2 stacks against {{tip|champions}}. The stacks refresh on subsequent attacks, stack up to 8 times, and expire one by one every {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the duration. |leveling = {{st|Passive Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:pb1}} to {{#var:pb5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:pap}}% AP)}}}} |description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' unleashes for 5 seconds: gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, dealing {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, and augmenting her basic attacks to have increased missile speed, a 40% lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} time, and an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}. Her basic attacks are also empowered to spread to each enemy near the target, dealing {{as|30% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.
Each spread attack {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 30% effectiveness, and will {{tip|critically strike}} if the triggering attack does. Spread attacks deal 250% damage against {{tip|minions}} {{as|below 30% '''maximum''' health}}. |leveling2 = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}} {{st|Active Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:ab1}} to {{#var:ab5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:aap}}% AP)}}|Combined Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:pb1}}+{{#var:ab1}} to {{#var:pb5}}+{{#var:ab5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:aap}}+{{#var:pap}}}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Active Increased Minion Damage|{{ap|{{#var:ab1}}*2.5 to {{#var:ab5}}*2.5}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:20*2.5}}% AP)}}|Combined Increased Minion Damage|{{ap|({{#var:pb1}}+{{#var:ab1}})*2.5 to ({{#var:pb5}}+{{#var:ab5}})*2.5}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:({{#var:aap}}+{{#var:pap}})*2.5}}% AP)}}}} |description3 = ''Cultivation of Spirit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Yunara's''' basic attack timer. Targets do not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the spread attacks.'' |cast time = none |effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Center-to-edge}} |cost = 30 |costtype = Mana + 8 Unleash Stacks |speed = {{dv|{{tt|10000|Empowered attack missile speed}}|{{tt|2000|Spread attack missile speed}}}} |queue time = {{fd|0.05}} |targeting = Auto |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = Physical Magic |spelleffects = special |spellshield = false |projectile = true |parry = unknown |notes = * ''Cultivation of Spirit's'' damage classifications: ** {{tip|Proc damage}} for the passive and active on-hit damage. ** {{tip|Basic damage}} for the spread attack damage. * The ''on-hit'' will {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for 0% '''bonus''' damage when the triggering attack does, causing it to be reduced by {{ii|Randuin's Omen}} but not be amped by {{ai|I|Yunara}}. {{bug|2}} * Spread attacks will still deal damage even if '''Yunara''' misses her basic attack due to {{tip|blind}}. * {{Pending for test}} Spread attack interaction with parrying effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}) * There is no limit to the number of enemies the empowered attacks can spread to. * '''Yunara's''' secondary resource bar gives various context for ''Cultivation of Spirit''. It is visible to the player only. ** While ''Cultivation of Spirit'' is not active, the bar shows her current ''Unleash'' stacks. It is colored white while below maximum stacks and yellow while at maximum stacks. ** After ''Cultivation of Spirit'' is cast, the bar counts down the buff's duration. *** This is also true during {{ai|Transcend One's Self|Yunara}}, which means that the bar effectively also counts down the duration of her ''Transcendent State''. * If '''Yunara''' begins an {{tip|attack windup}} toward the end of the active effects' duration and its launch would take place after it, the effects' duration is extended equal to the attack's windup time, once at most. ** Since the buff ends right after launching ''Cultivation of Spirit's'' attack and its effects have already been determined, this allows it to both spread to nearby enemies and generate a stack of ''Unleash''. * Each bolt from {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} may trigger its own spread attack (despite the spread attacks not being an on-hit effect). |tips = * While ''Cultivation of Spirit'' has no cooldown, the ability has a minimum downtime that is the time it takes for '''Yunara''' to generate 8 stacks. ** Against champions, this downtime is {{fd|{{#expr:4*1/{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}} round 2}}}} seconds at '''Yunara's''' base attack speed ({{as|{{fd|{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}}}}|attack speed}}), 20 seconds at minimum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|0.2}}|attack speed}}), and {{fd|1.{{Recurring|33}}}} seconds at maximum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|3.003}}|attack speed}}). ** Against non-champions, this downtime is {{fd|{{#expr:8*1/{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}} round 2}}}} seconds at '''Yunara's''' base attack speed ({{as|{{fd|{{ccd|Yunara|as_base}}}}|attack speed}}), 40 seconds at minimum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|0.2}}|attack speed}}), and {{fd|2.{{Recurring|66}}}} seconds at maximum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|3.003}}|attack speed}}). ** These can be further decreased with effects that allow exceeding the attack speed cap or reset the attack timer. |blurbicon = Yunara Cultivation of Spirit 2.png |blurb = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Yunara}} {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} and generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Unleash'' {{tip|on-attack}}, stacking up to a cap upon which she can cast ''Cultivation of Spirit''. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' unleashes for a few seconds: her basic attacks gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, deal {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, and spread to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies near the target. |blurb4 = The spread attack will apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and can {{tip|critically strike}}. }}

|champion     = Yunara
|skill        = W
|icon         = Yunara Arc of Ruin.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' fires a beam of spirit magic in the target direction that deals {{pp|160 to 480 for 3|1 to 3|type=[[File:Yunara Transcend One's Self.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Transcend One's Self's'' Rank|label1=Rank|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% decaying over 1 second, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|surrounding area|Cannot see through terrain nor brush}}.
|description2 = ''This ability {{tt|benefits from ultimate ability effects|See notes}} and is the upgraded version of {{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}} during {{ai|Transcend One's Self|Yunara|Transcendent State}}.''
|range        = {{tip|er|icononly=true}} 1150
|cast time    = {{pp|0.6 to 0.45 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|label= Bonus AS|color=attack speed}}

|cooldown     = 10
|cost         =

|spellshield  = true

|projectile   = false

* ''Arc of Ruin'' grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings during the cast time and for {{tt|{{fd|0.3}} seconds|Estimated}} afterwards.{{Effect at cast time end}}

R.name: Transcend One's Self
R.title: Template:Data Yunara/Transcend One's Self
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Transcend One's Self|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Yunara
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Yunara Transcend One's Self.png
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'' base damage and ''{{ais|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'' dash speed scale with ''Transcend One's Self's'' rank.
|leveling     = {{st|[[File: Yunara Arc of Ruin.png|20px|border|link=]] Arc of Ruin Base Damage|{{ap|160 to 480}}}}
{{st|[[File: Yunara Untouchable Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] Untouchable Shadow Dash Speed|{{ap|1350 to 1650}}}}
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' enters ''Transcendent State'' for 15 seconds, during which each of her basic abilities is empowered:
{{lc|{{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}}}} Automatically becomes active at no cost, with the duration increased to ''Transcendent State's''.
{{lc|{{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}} reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.
{{lc|{{ai|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|cooldown}} reset upon both entering and exiting the state.
|cooldown     = {{ap|100 to 80}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* An ongoing ''{{ais|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' effect is not lost when quickly replaced by ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}''.
* {{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}} is cast alongside ''Transcend One's Self''. If the former was not already active, this will also grant its {{tip|basic attack reset|attack reset}}.
** The attack reset does '''not''' originate from ''Transcend One's Self'' nor is ''Transcend One's Self'' tagged as granting one itself (e.g. for the purposes of {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
* ''Transcend One's Self'' cannot be cast again while active.
|flavorsound = {{sm2|Yunara_Original_R_1.ogg}} ''"Relentless fortitude!"''
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Yunara Transcend One's Self.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'' damage and {{ais|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}} dash speed are increased.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yunara}} enters ''Transcendent State'' for some time.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Transcendent State:}} '''Yunara''' gains ''{{ais|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}}'' active effect, ''{{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}'' and ''{{ai|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' are upgraded into ''{{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'' and ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}''.
|blurb4       = ''{{ais|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' and ''{{ais|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}'' cooldowns are reset and reduced, respectively, upon both entering and exiting the state.
}}
